enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Pull the blanket up over the chest. Remain still with arms under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Bend knees slightly. Keep eyes closed. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain motionless. Turn onto the back. Stretch the legs straight. Place one hand on the blanket edge. Turn onto the right side again. Keep breathing slowly with eyes closed. Remain in the same position until the alarm sounds at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and stretching in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Reach the right arm toward the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the side button to stop the alarm. Put the phone back on the table. Stretch both arms above the head. Stretch both legs out. Bend the knees and pull them toward the chest. Turn onto the left side. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Raise both arms overhead and stretch the back. Lower the arms. Put both hands on the knees.

Walk into the bathroom. Close the door. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the lever. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap and rub it over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse off the soap. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rack. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap and rinse the brush. Turn off the tap. Put the brush back in the holder. Turn off the light. Open the door and walk out.

Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate and a glass. Put the plate and glass on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put them on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Put the kettle on the base and press the switch to boil. Open the toaster door. Put the bread slices into the toaster. Press the lever down. Take the butter from the refrigerator. Open the refrigerator door. Take out butter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the butter lid. Pick up a knife. Spread butter on the toasted bread. Pour milk into the glass. Pick up the plate and glass. Carry them to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the bread and eat it. Pick up the glass and drink the milk. Wipe the mouth with a paper napkin. Stand up and carry the plate and glass to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Put the clothes on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Zip and button the trousers. Take the socks from the drawer. Put on the socks. Sit on the bed and put on the shoes. Tie the shoe laces. Take the work bag from the chair. Open the bag zipper. Insert the laptop into the bag. Insert the phone charger cable. Insert the notebook. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the bag and place it by the bedroom door.

Pick up the work bag. Pick up the keys from the hook. Open the front door. Step outside. Close and lock the front door. Put the keys into the pocket. Walk down the stairs. Press the button on the car key to unlock the car. Open the car door. Place the bag on the passenger seat. Sit in the driver seat. Fasten the seat belt. Insert the key and start the engine. Check the mirrors. Shift the gear and drive out of the parking lot. Stop at the traffic light. Press the turn signal. Drive along the main road. Stop at the second traffic light. Continue driving. Park the car in the clinic parking lot. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Take the bag from the passenger seat. Open the car door. Step out. Close the car door. Lock the car with the key. Walk toward the clinic entrance. Push the glass door open.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Put the bag into the locker. Close the locker door. Put on the work badge around the neck. Put on the gloves. Walk to the examination room. Press the computer power button. Log in with the password. Turn on the desk lamp. Pick up the phone and call the first patient into the room. Greet the patient. Sit on the chair. Take the patient's blood pressure with the cuff. Write the readings into the computer. Pick up the thermometer. Measure the temperature. Put the thermometer back into the holder. Type notes into the patient record. Stand up and open the cupboard. Take out a dressing pack. Close the cupboard door. Prepare the dressing. Apply the dressing to the patient's wound. Dispose of the used materials into the bin. Remove the gloves. Put on new gloves. Wash hands at the sink. Turn off the tap. Dry hands with paper towels. Type the treatment notes into the computer. Press the print button. Pick up the printed sheet. Hand it to the patient. Greet the patient goodbye. Repeat the examination with the following patients. Take a break at noon and walk to the staff room. Open the lunch box. Eat lunch with a fork. Drink water from the bottle. Walk back to the examination room. Continue the consultations. Answer the desk phone. Write down the appointment time on the notepad. Hang up the phone. At 17:00 log out of the computer. Shut down the computer. Take the bag out of the locker. Open the locker door and close it. Walk out of the clinic.

Walk to the car in the parking lot. Press the unlock button on the car key. Open the car door. Place the bag on the passenger seat. Sit in the driver seat. Fasten the seat belt. Start the engine. Shift the gear and drive out of the parking lot. Stop at the traffic light. Press the turn signal. Drive along the main road. Slow down at the pedestrian crossing. Continue driving through the intersection. Turn the steering wheel into the residential street. Park the car in front of the house. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Take the bag from the passenger seat. Open the car door. Step out. Close the car door. Lock the car with the key. Walk to the front door. Put the key into the lock and turn it. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door.

Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch. Turn on the tap. Put both hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Rub the backs of the hands. Rinse the hands under the water. Turn off the tap. Pull a paper towel from the holder. Dry the hands. Throw the paper towel into the bin. Turn on the tap again. Wet the face with both hands. Pick up the face towel from the rack. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back on the rack. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, chicken and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put the ingredients on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a cutting board. Put the cutting board on the counter. Wash the vegetables at the sink. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Put the pieces into a bowl. Cut the chicken into pieces. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the chicken pieces into the pan. Stir the chicken with a spatula. Add the vegetables into the pan. Add salt and stir. Turn down the heat. Press the switch to turn on the range hood. Break the eggs into a bowl. Beat the eggs with chopsticks. Pour the eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs. Turn off the induction cooker. Turn off the range hood. Take a plate from the cupboard. Scoop the food onto the plate. Pick up the plate and carry it to the table. Pick up the chopsticks. Sit on the chair. Eat the food with the chopsticks. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the plate and chopsticks to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the dishwasher and cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Pick up the plates from the sink. Place the plates into the rack. Pick up the chopsticks and place them into the basket. Pick up the pan and place it into the rack. Push the lower rack back in. Add detergent into the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the counter with the sponge. Rinse the sponge under the water. Turn off the tap. Wipe the table with a cloth. Wring the cloth over the sink. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the light. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk into the living room. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Pick up the remote control from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV and select a channel. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Sit on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Cross the legs. Watch the screen. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the phone. Scroll through messages. Type a reply message. Send the message. Lock the phone. Put the phone on the table. Pick up the remote again. Change the channel. Put the remote down. Stand up and walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the cap. Put the bottle on the table. Pick up the remote and turn up the volume. Watch the screen. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up. Turn off the light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer to read and study health care materials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit on the chair. Press the power button of the computer. Wait for the screen to light up. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Open the browser. Type the website address in the search bar. Press the Enter key. Open a health care article. Scroll down the page with the mouse wheel. Read the article on the screen. Open a second tab. Read the second article. Pick up the notebook from the desk. Pick up the pen. Write notes into the notebook. Put the pen down. Move the mouse and open another page. Read the page. Highlight a paragraph with the mouse. Copy the paragraph into a document. Type additional notes on the keyboard. Save the document with the Ctrl and S keys. Scroll the page again. Read to the end of the article. Close the browser tab. Close the browser. Shut down the computer. Press the monitor power button. Push the chair back under the desk. Stand up.

Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch to turn on the light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and body. Rinse off the soap. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel from the rack. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the bedroom. Sit on the bed. Pick up the remote control from the bedside table. Press the power button to turn on the TV. Point the remote at the TV. Select a channel. Put the remote on the bedside table. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the waist. Watch the TV screen. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the table. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the screen. Open a video. Watch the video on the phone. Lock the phone. Put the phone on the table. Turn onto the back. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Lower the volume. Put the remote down. Press the power button on the remote to turn off the TV. Put the remote on the bedside table.

Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the right side. Close eyes. Place the right arm under the pillow. Bend the knees. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Breathe slowly with eyes closed. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Remain motionless. Keep eyes closed. At 24:00 remain asleep in the same position on the bed.
